visibleTestCases.title: Credit and Query Balances
visibleTestCases.erlangCall: begin {ok, W} = wallet_server:start_link(#{<<"USD">> => 100}), wallet_server:credit(W, <<"EUR">>, 50), timer:sleep(20), Bals = wallet_server:get_balances(W), wallet_server:stop(W), Bals end
visibleTestCases.explanation: Asynchronously credits 50 EUR and retrieves current balance map.

visibleTestCases.title: Debit with Insufficient Funds
visibleTestCases.erlangCall: begin {ok, W} = wallet_server:start_link(#{<<"USD">> => 100}), Err = wallet_server:debit(W, <<"USD">>, 1000), wallet_server:stop(W), Err end
